result.title: DICL-Qwen3VL: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Interpretable Workwear Detection
result.summary: Poor illumination and occlusion obscure clothing cues in indoor work sites, while diverse clothing styles complicate workwear compliance judgments. Although vision-language models (VLMs) support localization and semantic reasoning, their predictions often lack explicit supporting evidence, and a single confidence score cannot distinguish visual uncertainty from ambiguity in compliance judgments. We propose DICL-Qwen3VL, a decoupled interpretable VLM that integrates structured workwear detection, evidence generation, and separate visual and reasoning confidence estimates. First, low-rank adaptation (LoRA) adapts Qwen3-VL to localize visible upper-body clothing and identify workwear. Second, decoupled calibration separates visual observations from compliance reasoning and assigns a confidence score to each. Token entropy and sensitivity to image perturbations provide supervision for visual confidence, linking confidence estimation to the generated observations and their dependence on image content. Finally, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) jointly optimizes detection accuracy, output validity, and confidence calibration. Experiments on the company-collected Indoor Construction Site Workwear Dataset (ICSWD) and the web-collected Indoor Construction Workwear Dataset (WICWD) yield mAP@50 values of 0.730 and 0.753, respectively, outperforming the evaluated LoRA-adapted VLM baselines, including Qwen3-VL. The framework also provides explicit evidence and separate confidence scores to support manual review in industrial safety monitoring. WICWD is publicly available at https://github.com/DaErwen1/WICWD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DICL-Qwen3VL，用 LoRA 适配 Qwen3-VL 完成室内工地工装定位与合规判断，将视觉观测置信度与合规推理置信度解耦标定，并用 token 熵与图像扰动敏感度监督视觉置信度，最后以 GRPO 联合优化检测精度、输出有效性与置信度校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「解耦标定」把视觉证据与推理不确定性分别赋分，且以 token 熵和扰动敏感度监督视觉置信度，这一思路可能为 LVR 中区分视觉旁路贡献与 latent 推理贡献、分配监督提供可核查的方法线索；但任务本身是工业检测应用，不直接研究 latent 推理。
